headline: PHP2Shell CISA deadline is tomorrow; Oracle E-Business Suite RCE under attack; attacker posing as AI bots scans for credentials

bullets.text: New: an attacker is relentlessly scanning for credentials while impersonating AI bots (Dark Reading). Help Net Security also reports compromised camera management software is giving attackers a way into corporate networks.

China-linked hackers are exploiting PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) to root firewalls. It leads at 8 outlets and CISA's federal due date is tomorrow, 2026-10-29. Fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

Hackers are targeting a critical Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw (CVE-2026-101767) days after Oracle's patch. The ShinyHunters-exploited PeopleSoft zero-day turned out to be three chained flaws, including CVE-2026-35273.

CISA warns hackers are exploiting the critical Node2Shell flaw. Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are in CISA KEV, due 2026-11-10. A critical 16-year-old UEFI flaw can run code before Secure Boot on network-booting servers.

Japan's GMO told customers to shut down and disconnect their PCs from the internet after a data breach and ransomware threat (4 outlets), and is offering a $1 million bounty over its FX trading cloud breach.

Breaches: 345,000 email addresses were stolen from Germany's AfD party; So-net (2.6M records), Bithumb and 123 Reg disclosed breaches; NT Health backtracked on its RDH breach count; ransomware still disrupts UNM Health.

actions: Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 before CISA's 2026-10-29 deadline, including firewalls and appliances, and check exposed hosts.
If you run Oracle E-Business Suite, apply Oracle's patch for CVE-2026-101767 now; PeopleSoft users should follow guidance for CVE-2026-35273 and review logs.
Find any Node2Shell-affected systems you run, apply the vendor's fix now and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Patch Adobe Commerce/Magento for CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497; check stores for webshells and unexpected uploads.
Review web logs for credential scanning from clients claiming to be AI bots, and don't allowlist bot user agents without verifying them.
Check camera management software for compromise and keep it off corporate network segments; apply UEFI firmware fixes for network-booting servers as they ship.
